sourceFile: 01. TIU L5S3-01 R Report test VP mold Korea - Forming D3  12.12.2025_1778470786_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: The workbook contains valid Normal vs Test comparisons, but the draft misstates the changed condition by adding Manual and mishandles Auto/Manual-style conditions as subgroup context.
issues: Changed factor is not verified as 'Normal vs Test, Manual'; cited visible evidence supports Normal lot vs Test lot, while Manual is not shown as a primary changed factor.
subgroupKeys contains only Auto, but Auto appears to be a drop-test method/secondary condition rather than the primary changed factor.
EvidenceRows include Test!31 and Test!33, but those row texts are not present in the supplied context, so their role cannot be independently verified here.
Measurement outcome has extraction issues: spec is blank despite row text showing 0.2 Kgf, and sampleCount appears to be 1 although multiple sample values are listed.
Measurement judgement is not_judged even though both Test and Normal pass; if retained, it should be framed as pass/pass with small average difference, not left as an ungrouped candidate.
correctionPlan: Revise changedFactor to a source-supported condition such as 'Normal lot vs Test VP lot' or 'Normal vs Test' tied to VP mold Korea/Forming D3 context.
Remove 'Manual' from changedCondition unless rows Test!31/Test!33 or other source rows prove Manual is part of the primary changed factor.
Treat Auto/Manual, if present, as drop-test method or subgroup/secondary condition only, not as the main changed condition.
Add or expose row text for Test!31 and Test!33 if they remain cited, or remove them from evidenceRows.
Correct the tension measurement extraction to include spec 0.2 Kgf and the actual multiple sample values/count, then decide whether to report it as pass/pass or a descriptive measurement comparison.
Keep the function defect, tension, and drop-test outcomes under one Normal vs Test review case because they belong to the same validation report.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations to the main comparison rows are generally sufficient, but unsupported/missing-row citations and the Manual/Auto grouping must be corrected before evidence can be approved.
